name: MaintainX
description: MaintainX is a mobile-first CMMS (computerized maintenance management system) for creating and tracking work orders, preventive maintenance schedules, and asset and parts records across manufacturing, facilities, and industrial teams.
best_for: Maintenance, reliability, and facilities teams that want a mobile-first way for frontline technicians to receive, complete, and document work orders and preventive maintenance without paper checklists.
features: Work order creation, assignment, and tracking across multiple sites, with AI-assisted guidance for frontline workers
Preventive and condition-based maintenance scheduling, including AI-assisted anomaly detection to flag issues before they cause downtime
Asset management with equipment health tracking and root-cause analysis
Digital procedures and checklists for enforcing safety and operating standards on every job
Parts and inventory management with stock alerts, reorder points, and AI-assisted demand prediction
Purchase orders and API access on higher-tier plans
Natural-language reporting that generates analytics from a plain-language description of what to measure
Native iOS and Android mobile apps for technicians in the field
pros: Genuinely free-forever Basic plan, not just a time-limited trial
Mobile-first design built around frontline technicians rather than a desktop tool adapted for mobile
SOC 2 and ISO 27001:2022 certified, notable for a CMMS at this price point
cons: The free Basic plan is capped at 2 work orders with procedures and 2 active repeating work orders, so most real teams will need a paid plan
Advanced features like asset health insights, IoT integrations, and SSO are reserved for the custom-priced Enterprise plan

pricing.starting_price: Free (Basic); paid plans from $20/user/month billed annually (Essential)

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: Free forever. Limited to 2 work orders with procedures, 2 active repeating work orders, and 1 month of analytics history.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.notes: $25/user/month if billed monthly. Unlimited work orders with images, 3 repeating work orders, and 3 months of analytics history.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: $75/user/month if billed monthly. Unlimited work orders with procedures and analytics, parts inventory, purchase orders, and API access. MaintainX's most popular plan.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing. Adds asset health insights, resource planning, IoT integrations, multi-site tools, and SSO.

alternatives.name: Procore
alternatives.description: Construction management software covering project management, financials, and field productivity for general contractors and owners.
alternatives.best_for: Construction firms managing entire projects (budgets, drawings, RFIs, subcontractors) rather than ongoing maintenance work orders for existing equipment and facilities.

alternatives.name: ServiceTitan
alternatives.description: Field service management software for residential and commercial trade businesses, covering scheduling, dispatch, and invoicing.
alternatives.best_for: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and other trade contractors running customer-facing service calls, rather than internal equipment and facilities maintenance teams.
strengths: Dispatch and scheduling for mobile technicians
Sales and marketing tools for trade businesses

faq.question: Is MaintainX free?
faq.answer: Yes. MaintainX's Basic plan is free forever, though it's capped at 2 work orders with procedures, 2 active repeating work orders, and 1 month of analytics history. Paid plans start at $20/user/month (billed annually) for more usage.

faq.question: Does MaintainX have a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes, MaintainX offers a free 30-day trial of its Premium plan with no credit card required.

faq.question: What compliance certifications does MaintainX have?
faq.answer: MaintainX has completed a SOC 2 audit, holds ISO 27001:2022 certification for its platform and Montreal office, and states it is GDPR-ready.
